name: What kind of subfloor is required for engineered hardwood installation?
description: Engineered hardwood requires a clean, dry, flat, and sound subfloor like concrete or plywood. Proper preparation prevents future flooring issues.

mainEntity.name: What kind of subfloor is required for engineered hardwood installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engineered hardwood flooring can be installed over various subfloor types, including concrete, plywood, or existing vinyl/tile, provided the surface is clean, dry, flat, and structurally sound. Proper subfloor preparation is critical; any unevenness exceeding 1/8 inch over a 6-foot span needs leveling to prevent future issues like creaking or separation. Hometelligent Inc. always includes a detailed subfloor inspection as part of our initial project assessment to identify and address any necessary preparations upfront.
